items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of taxi travel costs
items.quote: Wenn Sie mit unserer Entscheidung nicht einverstanden sind, legen Sie bitte innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch ein – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der BKK Musterwerk, Am Werkstor 12, 38440 Beispielsburg.
items.computation: Letter dated 07.05.2025 (Wed); absent other evidence, treated as the day of 'Aufgabe zur Post'. Under §37 Abs.2 SGB X (as amended with effect from 1 Jan 2025, extending the delivery fiction from 3 to 4 days), a letter sent by post is deemed delivered on the 4th day after mailing: 08.05 (Thu, day1) -> 09.05 (Fri, day2) -> 10.05 (Sat, day3) -> 11.05 (Sun, day4). Since the 4th day falls on a Sunday, the deemed-delivery (Bekanntgabe) day moves to the next business day: Monday 12.05.2025. The one-month Widerspruch period runs from Bekanntgabe per §26 Abs.1 SGB X i.V.m. §§187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB: the day of Bekanntgabe (12.05.2025) is not counted; the period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the Bekanntgabe day, i.e. 12.06.2025. That date is a Thursday and not a holiday in NRW, so no further shift applies. Widerspruch must reach the BKK by this date.

warnings: The exact posting date ('Aufgabe zur Post') is not printed on the letter; the computation assumes it matches the printed letter date (07.05.2025), which could shift the deemed-delivery date and thus the Widerspruch deadline.

The 4-day delivery fiction (instead of the former 3-day rule) under §37 Abs.2 SGB X applies because the amendment took effect 1 January 2025 and this letter is dated after that; verify against the current wording in force if this changes.
No specific amount of the denied taxi costs is stated in the letter, so no amount could be extracted.
